mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 2% for two consecutive months signals central bank over-tightening, which compresses equity discount rates and drives negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 2.0 and remains >2.0 for two consecutive months
regime_hint: accelerating inflation in a tightening cycle
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during inflation spikes (p > 0.05), or CPIAUCSL does not exceed 2.0 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in PAYEMS labor cost index exceeding 0.5% signals wage pressure that outpaces productivity (INDPRO), leading to higher expected future profits and positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >0.5% while INDPRO increases by ≤0.3% in the same month
regime_hint: wage growth outpacing productivity in labor market tightness
failure_condition: 60-day returns are negative despite consistent wage-productivity divergence (Rank IC < -0.1), or the wage index does not exceed 0.5% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in HOUST retail sales of >2% suggests weakening demand, which lowers future earnings expectations and produces negative 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: HOUST decreases by >2% in two consecutive months
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive during the identified demand weakness (p < 0.05), or sales decline is ≤1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in INDPRO manufacturing index (<3% over two months) indicates supply-side constraints that raise cost-to-earnings ratios, resulting in positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls by >3% over two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not statistically positive during supply shocks (p > 0.05), or INDPRO recovers >3% in two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 1% for three consecutive months indicates accommodative policy, lowering discount rates and pushing 60-day S&P 500 forward returns to positive territory.
failure_condition: 60-day returns remain negative despite policy easing (p > 0.05), or FEDFUNDS does not fall below 1% for three months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly UNRATE decline below 6% signals labor market softening, lowering real wage growth assumptions and producing negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 6.0% in a single month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative during rate declines (p > 0.05), or UNRATE does not fall below 6%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in GDPC1 (demand) and RSAFS (retail sales) by >4% in the same month indicate dual demand weakness, which depresses earnings expectations and drives negative 5-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < prev and RSAFS < prev by >4% in the same month
failure_condition: 5-day returns are positive despite the dual demand weakness (p < 0.05), or either proxy recovers >4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in INDPRO above 102 (3% above 2013 baseline) suggests supply expansion, lowering cost pressures and producing positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive during supply booms (p > 0.05), or INDPRO does not exceed 102 for two months.
